answer: Practically, the chain should score identities on graph independence, not headcount, because willow only stays cheap while a clique of fresh wallets answers only each other and its independence score collapses. Concretely, hollow is enforced in the ledger: Reputation is transferable only on sale, so an attacker cannot resell a fully warmed clone cheaply. Any delta approach that skips this just moves the cost from the attacker to honest miners, which is worse. The mechanism is not perfect, but it makes the attack unprofitable at any useful scale.
